821	type voteVerifier struct {
822		v              *View
823		proposal       *types.Proposal
824		expectedDigest string
825		validVotes     chan types.Signature
826	}
827	
828	func (vv *voteVerifier) verifyVote(vote *protos.Message) {
829		commit := vote.GetCommit()
830		if commit.Digest != vv.expectedDigest {
831			vv.v.Logger.Warnf("Got wrong digest at processCommits for seq %d", commit.Seq)
832			return
833		}
834	
835		_, err := vv.v.Verifier.VerifyConsenterSig(types.Signature{
836			ID:    commit.Signature.Signer,
837			Value: commit.Signature.Value,
838			Msg:   commit.Signature.Msg,
839		}, *vv.proposal)
840		if err != nil {
841			vv.v.Logger.Warnf("Couldn't verify %d's signature: %v", commit.Signature.Signer, err)
842			return
843		}
844	
845		vv.validVotes <- types.Signature{
846			ID:    commit.Signature.Signer,
847			Value: commit.Signature.Value,
848			Msg:   commit.Signature.Msg,
849		}
850	}
851	
852	func (v *View) decide(proposal *types.Proposal, signatures []types.Signature, requests []types.RequestInfo) {
853		v.Logger.Infof("Deciding on seq %d", v.ProposalSequence)
854		v.ViewSequences.Store(ViewSequence{ProposalSeq: v.ProposalSequence, ViewActive: true})
855		// first make preparations for the next sequence so that the view will be ready to continue right after delivery
856		v.startNextSeq()
857		signatures = append(signatures, *v.myProposalSig)
858		v.Decider.Decide(*proposal, signatures, requests)
859	}
860	
861	func (v *View) startNextSeq() {
862		prevSeq := v.ProposalSequence
863	
864		v.ProposalSequence++
865		v.DecisionsInView++
866	
867		nextSeq := v.ProposalSequence
868	
869		v.MetricsView.ProposalSequence.Set(float64(v.ProposalSequence))
870		v.MetricsView.DecisionsInView.Set(float64(v.DecisionsInView))
871	
872		v.Logger.Infof("Sequence: %d-->%d", prevSeq, nextSeq)
873	
874		// swap next prePrepare
875		tmp := v.prePrepare
876		v.prePrepare = v.nextPrePrepare
877		// clear tmp
878		for len(tmp) > 0 {
879			<-tmp
880		}
881		tmp = make(chan *protos.Message, 1)
882		v.nextPrePrepare = tmp
883	
884		// swap next prepares
885		tmpVotes := v.prepares
886		v.prepares = v.nextPrepares
887		tmpVotes.clear(v.N)
888		v.nextPrepares = tmpVotes
889	
890		// swap next commits
891		tmpVotes = v.commits
892		v.commits = v.nextCommits
893		tmpVotes.clear(v.N)
894		v.nextCommits = tmpVotes
895	}
896	
897	// GetMetadata returns the current sequence and view number (in a marshaled ViewMetadata protobuf message)
898	func (v *View) GetMetadata() []byte {
899		metadata := &protos.ViewMetadata{
900			ViewId:          v.Number,
901			LatestSequence:  v.ProposalSequence,
902			DecisionsInView: v.DecisionsInView,
903		}
904	
905		v.Logger.Debugf("GetMetadata with view %d, seq %d, dec %d", metadata.ViewId, metadata.LatestSequence, metadata.DecisionsInView)
906	
907		var (
908			prevSigs []*protos.Signature
909			prevProp *protos.Proposal
910		)
911		verificationSeq := v.Verifier.VerificationSequence()
912	
913		prevProp, prevSigs = v.RetrieveCheckpoint()
914	
915		prevMD := &protos.ViewMetadata{}
916		if err := proto.Unmarshal(prevProp.Metadata, prevMD); err != nil {
917			v.Logger.Panicf("Attempted to propose a proposal with invalid unchanged previous proposal view metadata: %v", err)
918		}
919	
920		metadata.BlackList = prevMD.BlackList
921	
922		metadata = v.metadataWithUpdatedBlacklist(metadata, verificationSeq, prevProp, prevSigs)
923		metadata = v.bindCommitSignaturesToProposalMetadata(metadata, prevSigs)
924	
925		return MarshalOrPanic(metadata)
926	}
927	
928	func (v *View) metadataWithUpdatedBlacklist(metadata *protos.ViewMetadata, verificationSeq uint64, prevProp *protos.Proposal, prevSigs []*protos.Signature) *protos.ViewMetadata {
929		var membershipChange bool
930		if v.MembershipNotifier != nil {
931			membershipChange = v.MembershipNotifier.MembershipChange()
932		}
933	
934		if verificationSeq == prevProp.VerificationSequence && !membershipChange {
935			v.Logger.Debugf("Proposing proposal %d with verification sequence of %d and %d commit signatures",
936				v.ProposalSequence, verificationSeq, len(prevSigs))
937			return v.updateBlacklistMetadata(metadata, prevSigs, prevProp.Metadata)
938		}
939	
940		if verificationSeq != prevProp.VerificationSequence {
941			v.Logger.Infof("Skipping updating blacklist due to verification sequence changing from %d to %d",
942				prevProp.VerificationSequence, verificationSeq)
943		}
944		if membershipChange {
945			v.Logger.Infof("Skipping updating blacklist due to membership change")
946		}
947	
948		return metadata
949	}
950	
951	// Propose broadcasts a prePrepare message with the given proposal
952	func (v *View) Propose(proposal types.Proposal) {
953		var prevSigs []*protos.Signature
954		if v.DecisionsPerLeader > 0 {
955			_, prevSigs = v.RetrieveCheckpoint()
956		}
957	
958		seq := v.ProposalSequence
959		msg := &protos.Message{
960			Content: &protos.Message_PrePrepare{
961				PrePrepare: &protos.PrePrepare{
962					View: v.Number,
963					Seq:  seq,
964					Proposal: &protos.Proposal{
965						Header:               proposal.Header,
966						Payload:              proposal.Payload,
967						Metadata:             proposal.Metadata,
968						VerificationSequence: uint64(proposal.VerificationSequence),
969					},
970					PrevCommitSignatures: prevSigs,
971				},
972			},
973		}
974		// Send the proposal to yourself in order to pre-prepare yourself and record
975		// it in the WAL before sending it to other nodes.
976		v.HandleMessage(v.LeaderID, msg)
977		v.Logger.Debugf("Proposing proposal sequence %d in view %d", seq, v.Number)
978	}
979	
980	func (v *View) bindCommitSignaturesToProposalMetadata(metadata *protos.ViewMetadata, prevSigs []*protos.Signature) *protos.ViewMetadata {
981		if v.DecisionsPerLeader == 0 {
982			v.Logger.Debugf("Leader rotation is disabled, will not bind signatures to proposals")
983			return metadata
984		}
985		metadata.PrevCommitSignatureDigest = CommitSignaturesDigest(prevSigs)
986	
987		if len(metadata.PrevCommitSignatureDigest) == 0 {
988			v.Logger.Debugf("No previous commit signatures detected")
989		} else {
990			v.Logger.Debugf("Bound %d commit signatures to proposal", len(prevSigs))
991		}
992		return metadata
993	}
994	
995	func (v *View) stop() {
996		v.stopOnce.Do(func() {
997			if v.abortChan == nil {
998				return
999			}
1000			close(v.abortChan)
1001		})
1002	}
1003	
1004	// Abort forces the view to end
1005	func (v *View) Abort() {
1006		v.stop()
1007		v.viewEnded.Wait()
1008	}
1009	
1010	func (v *View) Stopped() bool {
1011		select {
1012		case <-v.abortChan:
1013			return true
1014		default:
1015			return false
1016		}
1017	}
1018	
1019	func (v *View) AbortChan() <-chan struct{} {
1020		return v.abortChan
1021	}
1022	
1023	func (v *View) GetLeaderID() uint64 {
1024		return v.LeaderID
1025	}
1026	
1027	func (v *View) updateBlacklistMetadata(metadata *protos.ViewMetadata, prevSigs []*protos.Signature, prevMetadata []byte) *protos.ViewMetadata {
1028		if v.DecisionsPerLeader == 0 {
1029			v.Logger.Debugf("Rotation is disabled, setting blacklist to be empty")
1030			metadata.BlackList = nil
1031			return metadata
1032		}
1033	
1034		preparesFrom := make(map[uint64]*protos.PreparesFrom)
1035	
1036		for _, sig := range prevSigs {
1037			aux := v.Verifier.AuxiliaryData(sig.Msg)
1038			prpf := &protos.PreparesFrom{}
1039			if err := proto.Unmarshal(aux, prpf); err != nil {
1040				v.Logger.Panicf("Failed unmarshalling auxiliary data from previously persisted signatures: %v", err)
1041			}
1042			preparesFrom[sig.Signer] = prpf
1043		}
1044	
1045		prevMD := &protos.ViewMetadata{}
1046		if err := proto.Unmarshal(prevMetadata, prevMD); err != nil {
1047			v.Logger.Panicf("Attempted to propose a proposal with invalid previous proposal view metadata: %v", err)
1048		}
1049	
1050		_, f := computeQuorum(v.N)
1051	
1052		blacklist := &blacklist{
1053			currentLeader:      v.LeaderID,
1054			leaderRotation:     v.DecisionsPerLeader > 0,
1055			currView:           metadata.ViewId,
1056			prevMD:             prevMD,
1057			nodes:              v.NodesList,
1058			f:                  f,
1059			n:                  v.N,
1060			logger:             v.Logger,
1061			metricsBlacklist:   v.MetricsBlacklist,
1062			preparesFrom:       preparesFrom,
1063			decisionsPerLeader: v.DecisionsPerLeader,
1064		}
1065		metadata.BlackList = blacklist.computeUpdate()
1066		return metadata
1067	}
1068	
1069	func (v *View) blacklistingSupported(f int, myLastCommitSignatures []*protos.Signature) bool {
1070		// Once we blacklist, there is no way back. This is a one way trip, unless we downgrade the version
1071		// in all nodes and view change.
1072		if v.blacklistSupported {
1073			return true
1074		}
1075		// We wish to find whether there are f+1 witnesses for blacklisting being
1076		// activated among the signed commits of the previous proposal.
1077		var count int
1078		for _, commitSig := range myLastCommitSignatures {
1079			aux := v.Verifier.AuxiliaryData(commitSig.Msg)
1080			if len(aux) > 0 {
1081				count++
1082			}
1083		}
1084	
1085		v.Logger.Debugf("Found %d out of %d required witnesses for auxiliary data", count, f+1)
1086	
1087		blacklistSupported := count > f
1088	
1089		// We cache the result in case it is 'true'.
1090		// Subsequent invocations will skip the parsing.
1091		v.blacklistSupported = v.blacklistSupported || blacklistSupported
1092		return blacklistSupported
1093	}

311		c.Logger.Debugf("Heartbeat timeout expired, reported-view: %d, reported-leader: %d", view, leaderID)
312	
313		iAm, currentLeaderID := c.iAmTheLeader()
314		if iAm {
315			c.Logger.Debugf("Heartbeat timeout expired, this node is the leader, nothing to do; current-view: %d, current-leader: %d",
316				c.getCurrentViewNumber(), currentLeaderID)
317			return
318		}
319	
320		if leaderID != currentLeaderID {
321			c.Logger.Warnf("Heartbeat timeout expired, but current leader: %d, differs from reported leader: %d; ignoring", currentLeaderID, leaderID)
322			return
323		}

325		c.Logger.Warnf("Heartbeat timeout expired, complaining about leader: %d", leaderID)

329	// ProcessMessages dispatches the incoming message to the required component
330	func (c *Controller) ProcessMessages(sender uint64, m *protos.Message) {
331		c.Logger.Debugf("%d got message from %d: %s", c.ID, sender, MsgToString(m))
332		switch m.GetContent().(type) {
333		case *protos.Message_PrePrepare, *protos.Message_Prepare, *protos.Message_Commit:
334			c.currViewLock.RLock()
335			view := c.currView
336			c.currViewLock.RUnlock()
337			view.HandleMessage(sender, m)
338			c.ViewChanger.HandleViewMessage(sender, m)
339			if sender == c.leaderID() {
340				c.LeaderMonitor.InjectArtificialHeartbeat(sender, c.convertViewMessageToHeartbeat(m))
341			}
342		case *protos.Message_ViewChange, *protos.Message_ViewData, *protos.Message_NewView:
343			c.ViewChanger.HandleMessage(sender, m)
344		case *protos.Message_HeartBeat, *protos.Message_HeartBeatResponse:
345			c.LeaderMonitor.ProcessMsg(sender, m)
346		case *protos.Message_StateTransferRequest:
347			c.respondToStateTransferRequest(sender)
348		case *protos.Message_StateTransferResponse:
349			c.Collector.HandleMessage(sender, m)
350		default:
351			c.Logger.Warnf("Unexpected message type, ignoring")
352		}
353	}

384	func (c *Controller) startView(proposalSequence uint64) {
385		view, initPhase := c.ProposerBuilder.NewProposer(c.leaderID(), proposalSequence, c.currViewNumber, c.currDecisionsInView, c.quorum)
386	
387		c.currViewLock.Lock()
388		c.currView = view
389		c.currView.Start()
390		c.currViewLock.Unlock()
391	
392		role := Follower
393		leader, _ := c.iAmTheLeader()
394		if leader {
395			if initPhase == COMMITTED || initPhase == ABORT {
396				c.Logger.Debugf("Acquiring leader token when starting view with phase %s", initPhase.String())
397				c.acquireLeaderToken()
398			} else {
399				c.Logger.Debugf("Not acquiring leader token when starting view with phase %s", initPhase.String())
400			}
401			role = Leader
402		}
403		c.LeaderMonitor.ChangeRole(role, c.currViewNumber, c.leaderID())
404		c.Logger.Infof("Starting view with number %d, sequence %d, and decisions %d", c.currViewNumber, proposalSequence, c.currDecisionsInView)

407	func (c *Controller) changeView(newViewNumber uint64, newProposalSequence uint64, newDecisionsInView uint64) {
408		latestView := c.getCurrentViewNumber()
409		if latestView > newViewNumber {
410			c.Logger.Debugf("Got view change to %d but already at %d", newViewNumber, latestView)
411			return
412		}
413	
414		leader := c.currentViewLeader()
415		stopped := c.currentViewStopped()
416	
417		if !stopped && latestView == newViewNumber && c.leaderID() == leader &&
418			c.getCurrentDecisionsInView() == newDecisionsInView {
419			c.Logger.Debugf("Got view change to %d but view is already running", newViewNumber)
420			return
421		}
422	
423		if !c.abortView(latestView) {
424			return
425		}
426	
427		c.setCurrentViewNumber(newViewNumber)
428		c.setCurrentDecisionsInView(newDecisionsInView)
429		c.Logger.Debugf("Starting view after setting decisions in view to %d", newDecisionsInView)
430		c.startView(newProposalSequence)
431	
432		if iAm, _ := c.iAmTheLeader(); iAm {
433			c.Batcher.Reset()
434		}
435	}

437	func (c *Controller) abortView(view uint64) bool {
438		currView := c.getCurrentViewNumber()
439		c.Logger.Debugf("view for abort %d, current view %d", view, currView)
440	
441		if view < currView {
442			c.Logger.Debugf("Was asked to abort view %d but the current view with number %d", view, currView)
443			return false
444		}
445	
446		// Drain the leader token in case we held it,
447		// so we won't start proposing after view change.
448		c.relinquishLeaderToken()
449	
450		// Kill current view
451		c.Logger.Debugf("Aborting current view with number %d", c.currViewNumber)
452		c.currView.Abort()
453	
454		return true
455	}

484	func (c *Controller) propose() {
485		if c.stopped() || c.Batcher.Closed() {
486			return
487		}
488		nextBatch := c.Batcher.NextBatch()
489		if len(nextBatch) == 0 { // no requests in this batch
490			c.acquireLeaderToken() // try again later
491			return
492		}
493		metadata := c.currView.GetMetadata()
494		proposal := c.Assembler.AssembleProposal(metadata, nextBatch)
495		c.currView.Propose(proposal)
496	}

498	func (c *Controller) run() {
499		// At exit, always make sure to kill current view
500		// and wait for it to finish.
501		defer func() {
502			c.Logger.Infof("Exiting controller run; ID: %d", c.ID)
503			c.currView.Abort()
504		}()
505	
506		for {
507			select {
508			case d := <-c.decisionChan:
509				c.decide(d)
510			case newView := <-c.viewChange:
511				c.Logger.Debugf("get newView from viewChange")
512				c.changeView(newView.viewNumber, newView.proposalSeq, 0)
513			case view := <-c.abortViewChan:
514				c.abortView(view)
515			case <-c.stopChan:
516				return
517			case <-c.leaderToken:
518				c.propose()
519			case <-c.syncChan:
520				c.Logger.Debugf("get msg from syncChan")
521				view, seq, dec := c.sync()
522				c.MaybePruneRevokedRequests()
523				if view > 0 || seq > 0 {
524					c.changeView(view, seq, dec)
525				} else {
526					c.Logger.Debugf("view and seq is zero")
527					vs := c.ViewSequences.Load()
528					if vs == nil {
529						c.Logger.Panicf("ViewSequences is nil")
530					}
531					c.changeView(c.getCurrentViewNumber(), vs.(ViewSequence).ProposalSeq, c.getCurrentDecisionsInView())
532				}
533			}
534		}
535	}

537	func (c *Controller) decide(d decision) {
538		c.Logger.Debugf("Delivering to app from Controller decide the last decision proposal")
539		reconfig := c.Deliver.Deliver(d.proposal, d.signatures)
540		if reconfig.InLatestDecision {
541			c.close()
542		}
543		c.Logger.Debugf("Node %d delivered proposal", c.ID)
544		c.removeDeliveredFromPool(d)
545		select {
546		case c.deliverChan <- struct{}{}:
547		case <-c.stopChan:
548			return
549		}
550		c.incrementCurrentDecisionsInView()
551	
552		md := &protos.ViewMetadata{}
553		if err := proto.Unmarshal(d.proposal.Metadata, md); err != nil {
554			c.Logger.Panicf("Failed to unmarshal proposal metadata, error: %v", err)
555		}
556	
557		if c.checkIfRotate(md.BlackList) {
558			c.Logger.Debugf("Restarting view to rotate the leader")
559			c.changeView(c.getCurrentViewNumber(), md.LatestSequence+1, c.getCurrentDecisionsInView())
560			c.Logger.Debugf("Restarting timers in request pool due to leader rotation")
561			c.RequestPool.RestartTimers()
562		}
563		c.MaybePruneRevokedRequests()
564		if iAm, _ := c.iAmTheLeader(); iAm {
565			c.acquireLeaderToken()
566		}
567	}

569	func (c *Controller) checkIfRotate(blacklist []uint64) bool {
570		view := c.getCurrentViewNumber()
571		decisionsInView := c.getCurrentDecisionsInView()
572		c.Logger.Debugf("view(%d) + (decisionsInView(%d) / decisionsPerLeader(%d)), N(%d), blacklist(%v)",
573			view, decisionsInView, c.DecisionsPerLeader, c.N, blacklist)
574		// called after increment
575		currLeader := getLeaderID(view, c.N, c.NodesList, c.LeaderRotation, decisionsInView-1, c.DecisionsPerLeader, blacklist)
576		nextLeader := getLeaderID(view, c.N, c.NodesList, c.LeaderRotation, decisionsInView, c.DecisionsPerLeader, blacklist)
577		shouldWeRotate := currLeader != nextLeader
578		if shouldWeRotate {
579			c.Logger.Infof("Rotating leader from %d to %d", currLeader, nextLeader)
580		}
581	
582		return shouldWeRotate
583	}

585	func (c *Controller) sync() (viewNum uint64, seq uint64, decisions uint64) {
586		// Block any concurrent sync attempt.
587		c.grabSyncToken()
588		// At exit, enable sync once more, but ignore
589		// all synchronization attempts done while
590		// we were syncing.
591		defer c.relinquishSyncToken()
592	
593		c.syncLock.Lock()
594		defer c.syncLock.Unlock()
595	
596		syncResponse := c.Synchronizer.Sync()
597		if syncResponse.Reconfig.InReplicatedDecisions {
598			c.close()
599			c.ViewChanger.close()
600		}
601	
602		// The synchronizer returns a response which includes the latest decision with its proposal metadata.
603		// This proposal may be empty (its metadata is empty), meaning the synchronizer is not aware of any decisions made.
604		// Otherwise, the latest proposal sequence returned may be higher than our latest sequence, meaning we should
605		// update the checkpoint.
606		// In other cases we should not update the checkpoint.
607		// However, we always must fetch the latest state from other nodes,
608		// since the view may have advanced without this node and with no decisions.
609	
610		var newViewNum, newProposalSequence, newDecisionsInView uint64
611	
612		latestDecision := syncResponse.Latest
613		var latestDecisionSeq, latestDecisionViewNum, latestDecisionDecisions uint64
614		var latestDecisionMetadata *protos.ViewMetadata
615		if len(latestDecision.Proposal.Metadata) == 0 {
616			c.Logger.Infof("Synchronizer returned with an empty proposal metadata")
617			latestDecisionMetadata = nil
618		} else {
619			md := &protos.ViewMetadata{}
620			if err := proto.Unmarshal(latestDecision.Proposal.Metadata, md); err != nil {
621				c.Logger.Panicf("Controller was unable to unmarshal the proposal metadata returned by the Synchronizer")
622			}
623			latestDecisionSeq = md.LatestSequence
624			latestDecisionViewNum = md.ViewId
625			latestDecisionDecisions = md.DecisionsInView
626			latestDecisionMetadata = md
627		}
628	
629		controllerSequence := c.latestSeq()
630		newProposalSequence = controllerSequence + 1
631	
632		controllerViewNum := c.currViewNumber
633		newViewNum = controllerViewNum
634	
635		newDecisionsInView = c.getCurrentDecisionsInView()
636	
637		if latestDecisionSeq > controllerSequence {
638			c.Logger.Infof("Synchronizer returned with sequence %d while the controller is at sequence %d", latestDecisionSeq, controllerSequence)
639			c.Logger.Debugf("Node %d is setting the checkpoint after sync returned with view %d and seq %d", c.ID, latestDecisionViewNum, latestDecisionSeq)
640			c.Checkpoint.Set(latestDecision.Proposal, latestDecision.Signatures)
641			c.verificationSequence.Store(uint64(latestDecision.Proposal.VerificationSequence))
642			newProposalSequence = latestDecisionSeq + 1
643			newDecisionsInView = latestDecisionDecisions + 1
644		}
645	
646		if latestDecisionViewNum > controllerViewNum {
647			c.Logger.Infof("Synchronizer returned with view number %d while the controller is at view number %d", latestDecisionViewNum, controllerViewNum)
648			newViewNum = latestDecisionViewNum
649		}
650	
651		response := c.fetchState()
652		if response == nil {
653			c.Logger.Infof("Fetching state failed")
654			if latestDecisionMetadata == nil || latestDecisionViewNum < controllerViewNum {
655				// And the synchronizer did not return a new view
656				return 0, 0, 0
657			}
658		} else {
659			if response.View <= controllerViewNum && latestDecisionViewNum < controllerViewNum {
660				return 0, 0, 0 // no new view to report
661			}
662			if response.View > newViewNum && response.Seq == latestDecisionSeq+1 {
663				c.Logger.Infof("Node %d collected state with view %d and sequence %d", c.ID, response.View, response.Seq)
664				newViewToSave := &protos.SavedMessage{
665					Content: &protos.SavedMessage_NewView{
666						NewView: &protos.ViewMetadata{
667							ViewId:          response.View,
668							LatestSequence:  latestDecisionSeq,
669							DecisionsInView: 0,
670						},
671					},
672				}
673				if err := c.State.Save(newViewToSave); err != nil {
674					c.Logger.Panicf("Failed to save message to state, error: %v", err)
675				}
676				newViewNum = response.View
677				newDecisionsInView = 0
678			}
679		}
680	
681		if latestDecisionMetadata != nil {
682			c.maybePruneInFlight(latestDecisionMetadata)
683		}
684	
685		if newViewNum > controllerViewNum {
686			c.Logger.Debugf("Node %d is informing the view changer of view %d after sync of view %d and seq %d", c.ID, newViewNum, latestDecisionViewNum, latestDecisionSeq)
687			c.ViewChanger.InformNewView(newViewNum)
688		}
689	
690		return newViewNum, newProposalSequence, newDecisionsInView
691	}
692	
693	func (c *Controller) maybePruneInFlight(syncResultViewMD *protos.ViewMetadata) {
694		inFlight := c.InFlight.InFlightProposal()
695		if inFlight == nil {
696			c.Logger.Debugf("No in-flight proposal to prune")
697			return
698		}
699		inFlightMD := &protos.ViewMetadata{}
700		if err := proto.Unmarshal(inFlight.Metadata, inFlightMD); err != nil {
701			c.Logger.Panicf("In-flight proposal was malformed: %v", err)
702		}
703		c.Logger.Debugf("In-flight proposal: view: %d, seq: %d", inFlightMD.ViewId, inFlightMD.LatestSequence)
704		c.Logger.Debugf("Sync result: view: %d, seq: %d", syncResultViewMD.ViewId, syncResultViewMD.LatestSequence)
705	
706		// If in-flight sequence is higher than latest committed sequence then in-flight might still be relevant
707		if syncResultViewMD.LatestSequence < inFlightMD.LatestSequence {
708			c.Logger.Infof("In-flight sequence is %d but latest committed sequence is %d, will not delete in-flight", inFlightMD.LatestSequence, syncResultViewMD.LatestSequence)
709			return
710		}
711		// Else we have replicated the in-flight proposal from another node or have committed it in the past,
712		// so we whenever we participate in a view change there will be no need to present this in-flight
713		// as we have corresponding signatures on the proposal.
714		c.Logger.Infof("Synced to sequence %d, deleting in-flight as it is stale", syncResultViewMD.LatestSequence)
715		c.InFlight.clear()
716	}
717	
718	func (c *Controller) fetchState() *types.ViewAndSeq {
719		msg := &protos.Message{
720			Content: &protos.Message_StateTransferRequest{
721				StateTransferRequest: &protos.StateTransferRequest{},
722			},
723		}
724		c.Collector.ClearCollected()
725		c.BroadcastConsensus(msg)
726		return c.Collector.CollectStateResponses()
727	}
728	
729	func (c *Controller) grabSyncToken() {
730		select {
731		case c.syncChan <- struct{}{}:
732		default:
733		}
734	}
735	
736	func (c *Controller) relinquishSyncToken() {
737		select {
738		case <-c.syncChan:
739		default:
740		}
741	}
742	
743	// MaybePruneRevokedRequests prunes requests with different verification sequence
744	func (c *Controller) MaybePruneRevokedRequests() {
745		oldVerSqn := c.verificationSequence.Load()
746		newVerSqn := c.Verifier.VerificationSequence()
747		if newVerSqn == oldVerSqn {
748			return
749		}
750		c.verificationSequence.Store(newVerSqn)
751	
752		c.Logger.Infof("Verification sequence changed: %d --> %d", oldVerSqn, newVerSqn)
753		c.RequestPool.Prune(func(req []byte) error {
754			_, err := c.Verifier.VerifyRequest(req)
755			return err
756		})
757	}
758	
759	func (c *Controller) acquireLeaderToken() {
760		select {
761		case c.leaderToken <- struct{}{}:
762		default:
763			// No room, seems we're already a leader.
764		}
765	}
766	
767	func (c *Controller) relinquishLeaderToken() {
768		select {
769		case <-c.leaderToken:
770		default:
771		}
772	}
773	
774	func (c *Controller) syncOnStart(startViewNumber uint64, startProposalSequence uint64, startDecisionsInView uint64) (viewNum uint64, seq uint64, decisions uint64) {
775		syncView, syncSeq, syncDecsions := c.sync()
776		c.MaybePruneRevokedRequests()
777		viewNum = startViewNumber
778		seq = startProposalSequence
779		decisions = startDecisionsInView
780		if syncView > startViewNumber {
781			viewNum = syncView
782			decisions = syncDecsions
783		}
784		if syncSeq > startProposalSequence {
785			seq = syncSeq
786			decisions = syncDecsions
787		}
788		return viewNum, seq, decisions
789	}
790	
791	// Start the controller
792	func (c *Controller) Start(startViewNumber uint64, startProposalSequence uint64, startDecisionsInView uint64, syncOnStart bool) {
793		c.Logger.Debugf("Starting controller with view %d, sequence %d, and decisions %d", startViewNumber, startProposalSequence, startDecisionsInView)
794		c.controllerDone.Add(1)
795		c.stopOnce = sync.Once{}
796		c.syncChan = make(chan struct{}, 1)
797		c.stopChan = make(chan struct{})
798		c.leaderToken = make(chan struct{}, 1)
799		c.decisionChan = make(chan decision, 1)
800		c.deliverChan = make(chan struct{})
801		c.viewChange = make(chan viewInfo, 1)
802		c.abortViewChan = make(chan uint64, 1)
803	
804		Q, F := computeQuorum(c.N)
805		c.Logger.Debugf("The number of nodes (N) is %d, F is %d, and the quorum size is %d", c.N, F, Q)
806		c.quorum = Q
807	
808		c.verificationSequence.Store(c.Verifier.VerificationSequence())
809	
810		if syncOnStart {
811			startViewNumber, startProposalSequence, startDecisionsInView = c.syncOnStart(startViewNumber, startProposalSequence, startDecisionsInView)
812			c.Logger.Debugf("After sync starting controller with view %d, sequence %d, and decisions %d", startViewNumber, startProposalSequence, startDecisionsInView)
813		}
814	
815		c.currViewNumber = startViewNumber
816		c.currDecisionsInView = startDecisionsInView
817		c.startView(startProposalSequence)
818	
819		go func() {
820			defer c.controllerDone.Done()
821			c.run()
822		}()
823	
824		c.StartedWG.Done()
825	}
826	
827	func (c *Controller) close() {
828		c.stopOnce.Do(
829			func() {
830				select {
831				case <-c.stopChan:
832					return
833				default:
834					close(c.stopChan)
835				}
836			},
837		)
838	}
839	
840	// Stop the controller
841	func (c *Controller) Stop() {
842		c.close()
843		c.Batcher.Close()
844		c.RequestPool.Close()
845		c.LeaderMonitor.Close()
846	
847		// Drain the leader token if we hold it.
848		select {
849		case <-c.leaderToken:
850		default:
851			// Do nothing
852		}
853	
854		c.controllerDone.Wait()
855	}
856	
857	// StopWithPoolPause the controller but only stop the requests pool timers
858	func (c *Controller) StopWithPoolPause() {
859		c.close()
860		c.Batcher.Close()
861		c.RequestPool.StopTimers()
862		c.LeaderMonitor.Close()
863	
864		// Drain the leader token if we hold it.
865		select {
866		case <-c.leaderToken:
867		default:
868			// Do nothing
869		}
870	
871		c.controllerDone.Wait()
872	}
873	
874	func (c *Controller) stopped() bool {
875		select {
876		case <-c.stopChan:
877			return true
878		default:
879			return false
880		}
881	}
882	
883	// Decide delivers the decision to the application
884	func (c *Controller) Decide(proposal types.Proposal, signatures []types.Signature, requests []types.RequestInfo) {
885		select {
886		case c.decisionChan <- decision{
887			proposal:   proposal,
888			requests:   requests,
889			signatures: signatures,
890		}:
891		case <-c.stopChan:
892			// In case we are in the middle of shutting down,
893			// abort deciding.
894			return
895		}
896	
897		select {
898		case <-c.deliverChan: // wait for the delivery of the decision to the application
899		case <-c.stopChan: // If we stopped the controller, abort delivery
900		case <-c.currentViewAbortChan(): // If we stopped the view, abort delivery
901		}
902	}
903	
904	func (c *Controller) removeDeliveredFromPool(d decision) {
905		for _, reqInfo := range d.requests {
906			if err := c.RequestPool.RemoveRequest(reqInfo); err != nil {
907				c.Logger.Debugf("Request %s wasn't found in the pool : %s", reqInfo, err)
908			}
909		}
910	}
911	
912	type viewInfo struct {
913		viewNumber  uint64
914		proposalSeq uint64
915	}
916	
917	type decision struct {
918		proposal   types.Proposal
919		signatures []types.Signature
920		requests   []types.RequestInfo
921	}
922	
923	// BroadcastConsensus broadcasts the message and informs the heartbeat monitor if necessary
924	func (c *Controller) BroadcastConsensus(m *protos.Message) {
925		for _, node := range c.NodesList {
926			// Do not send to yourself
927			if c.ID == node {
928				continue
929			}
930			c.Comm.SendConsensus(node, m)
931		}
932	
933		if m.GetPrePrepare() != nil || m.GetPrepare() != nil || m.GetCommit() != nil {
934			if leader, _ := c.iAmTheLeader(); leader {
935				c.LeaderMonitor.HeartbeatWasSent()
936			}
937		}
938	}
939	
940	type MutuallyExclusiveDeliver struct {
941		C *Controller
942	}
943	
944	func (med *MutuallyExclusiveDeliver) Deliver(proposal types.Proposal, signature []types.Signature) types.Reconfig {
945		pendingProposalMetadata := &protos.ViewMetadata{}
946		if err := proto.Unmarshal(proposal.Metadata, pendingProposalMetadata); err != nil {
947			med.C.Logger.Panicf("Failed unmarshalling metadata of pending proposal: %v", err)
948		}
949		med.C.syncLock.Lock()
950		defer med.C.syncLock.Unlock()
951	
952		// Fetch latest sequence from the latest checkpoint and compare it to the proposal that is about to be committed (pending).
953		// If the pending proposal's sequence has already been committed in the past,
954		// do not proceed to commit the proposal, but instead invoke a sync and update the checkpoint once more
955		// to match the sync result.
956		latest := med.C.latestSeq()
957		if latest != 0 && latest >= pendingProposalMetadata.LatestSequence {
958			med.C.Logger.Infof("Attempted to deliver block %d via view change but meanwhile view change already synced to seq %d, "+
959				"returning result from sync", pendingProposalMetadata.LatestSequence, latest)
960			syncResult := med.C.Synchronizer.Sync()
961			med.C.Checkpoint.Set(syncResult.Latest.Proposal, syncResult.Latest.Signatures)
962			return types.Reconfig{
963				CurrentNodes:     syncResult.Reconfig.CurrentNodes,
964				InLatestDecision: syncResult.Reconfig.InReplicatedDecisions,
965				CurrentConfig:    syncResult.Reconfig.CurrentConfig,
966			}
967		}
968	
969		begin := time.Now()
970		result := med.C.Application.Deliver(proposal, signature)
971		med.C.MetricsView.LatencyBatchSave.Observe(time.Since(begin).Seconds())
972	
973		// Only set the proposal in case it is later than the already known checkpoint.
974		med.C.Checkpoint.Set(proposal, signature)
975	
976		return result
977	}

commit 62e71617084b47f988fe476a02594f1ccc17d776
Author: ivan-atme <ivan.laishevskiy@atme.com>
Date:   Thu Apr 30 13:39:40 2026 +0400

    Fix DecisionsInView reset to zero during same-height sync (#663)
    
    * Fix DecisionsInView reset to zero during same-height sync
    
    When sync() is called but the synchronizer returns the same block height
    as the controller ("already at target height"), newDecisionsInView stays
    at its zero-initialized value because the update at line 641 is guarded
    by `latestDecisionSeq > controllerSequence`, which is false when equal.
    
    This zero is passed to changeView(), resetting DecisionsInView from its
    correct value (e.g. 9578) to 0. The next proposal from the leader carries
    the correct DecisionsInView, fails validation at view.go:577, and is
    rejected as "bad proposal", triggering a recovery sync loop that costs
    ~10 seconds per cycle and can cause orderers to fall permanently behind.
    
    Fix: decouple the DecisionsInView update from the checkpoint update by
    moving it to a separate `if latestDecisionMetadata != nil` block, so
    decisions are always derived from sync response metadata regardless of
    whether the sequence advanced.
    
    Signed-off-by: ivan-atme <ivan.laishevskiy@atme.com>
    
    * fix review comments
    
    Signed-off-by: ivan-atme <ivan.laishevskiy@atme.com>

    Signed-off-by: ivan-atme <ivan.laishevskiy@atme.com>

    by `latestDecisionSeq > controllerSequence`, which is false when equal.

    correct value (e.g. 9578) to 0. The next proposal from the leader carries
    the correct DecisionsInView, fails validation at view.go:577, and is
    rejected as "bad proposal", triggering a recovery sync loop that costs
    ~10 seconds per cycle and can cause orderers to fall permanently behind.

    moving it to a separate `if latestDecisionMetadata != nil` block, so
    decisions are always derived from sync response metadata regardless of
    whether the sequence advanced.

commit 93a878602b002b9b7c9cec089c4e19c112084ba7
Author: yacovm <yacovm@users.noreply.github.com>
Date:   Wed Jan 5 14:16:16 2022 +0200

    Synchronize Sync and view change proposal deliver to prevent a double commit (#484)
    
    This commit fixes a bug in which a node is unaware of a proposal being committed
    by the rest of the nodes, and it attempts a view change which fails, and triggers
    a view change timeout, which in turn triggers a sync.
    
    the asynchronous sync procedure may then commit that proposal, and the proposal
    will later on be attempted to be committed again once the view change resumes
    its operation, because the two procedures are parallel.
    
    The easy and trivial way of solving this would be to make the view change
    block until the sync process has ended. While this might work, it makes
    the single-threaded view change be dependant on network I/O, which is
    might slow down view change for other nodes due to votes being late.
    
    Instead, this commit highjacks the view change commit process and:
    1) Waits for any active sync to finish and prevents any syncs from occuring
    2) Checks the latest sequence committed and if the proposal being attempted
       to be committed by the view change is stale, it calls sync which
       would return either the last proposal committed, or a later one.
    
    Signed-off-by: Yacov Manevich <yacovm@il.ibm.com>
    
    Co-authored-by: C0rWin <artem@bargr.net>
===

    2) Checks the latest sequence committed and if the proposal being attempted
       to be committed by the view change is stale, it calls sync which

commit 0ac141d94d97930f7d4baef6166337d0af64e46a
Author: yacovm <yacovm@users.noreply.github.com>
Date:   Wed Jan 5 12:00:27 2022 +0200

    Delete in-flight when syncing past the in-flight sequence (#481)
    
    * Synchronize Sync and view change proposal deliver to prevent a double commit
    
    This commit fixes a bug in which a node is unaware of a proposal being committed
    by the rest of the nodes, and it attempts a view change which fails, and triggers
    a view change timeout, which in turn triggers a sync.
    
    the asynchronous sync procedure may then commit that proposal, and the proposal
    will later on be attempted to be committed again once the view change resumes
    its operation, because the two procedures are parallel.
    
    The easy and trivial way of solving this would be to make the view change
    block until the sync process has ended. While this might work, it makes
    the single-threaded view change be dependant on network I/O, which is
    might slow down view change for other nodes due to votes being late.
    
    Instead, this commit highjacks the view change commit process and:
    1) Waits for any active sync to finish and prevents any syncs from occuring
    2) Checks the latest sequence committed and if the proposal being attempted
       to be committed by the view change is stale, it calls sync which
       would return either the last proposal committed, or a later one.
    
    Signed-off-by: Yacov Manevich <yacovm@il.ibm.com>
    
    * Properly handle ticks when waiting for In-Flight view to finish
    
    Due to a bug, When the view changer initializes an in-flight view it only waits for a single tick
    before resuming view change standard operation.
    
    Another part of the bug is that it anyway returns success, which in turn makes the sequence of the controller
    be initialized to an old sequence.
    
    Signed-off-by: Yacov Manevich <yacovm@il.ibm.com>
    
    * Delete in-flght when syncing past the in-flight sequence
    
    In case a node syncs past its last recorded in-flight proposal, it needs to delete the in-flight because the rest of the nodes
    have progressed further than this in-flight proposal.
    
    Hence, it will never need to initialize a view to consent on the in-flight proposal since during the sync it has already committed this proposal.
    
    Even if there are some nodes that still consider the response to be in-flight, the current node can make them commit this proposal as it has corresponding
    signatures from the decision of this proposal.
    
    Signed-off-by: Yacov Manevich <yacovm@il.ibm.com>

content.thinking:
Now I have a thorough understanding of the system and all the relevant bugs. Let me analyze the key issues:

## Key bugs and findings found:

### 1. **Deliver Twice / Double Commit** (Family: Sync-ViewChange Race)
- **Commit 93a8786**: Synchronize Sync and view change proposal deliver to prevent a double commit
  - A node is unaware of a proposal being committed, attempts view change which fails, triggers a view change timeout, which in turn triggers a sync. The async sync procedure may commit that proposal, then the proposal is attempted to be committed again via view change.
- Fixed by introducing a `MutuallyExclusiveDeliver` wrapper that holds a `syncLock` to ensure mutual exclusion between sync and view change delivery paths.
- **Commit 57f434c**: The wrapper struct checks if a sequence has already been committed before delivering, preventing duplicate commits.
- **Commit d9182ed**: Further refinement moved the checkpoint setting from `decide()` into `MutuallyExclusiveDeliver.Deliver()` to ensure it only happens once during the delivery process.

Another issue emerged with `DecisionsInView` being reset to zero during same-height syncs. When the synchronizer returns the same block height as the controller, the `newDecisionsInView` update gets skipped due to a guard condition, causing the value to stay at zero and get passed to `changeView()`. This resets the counter from its actual value (like 9578) down to zero, which then fails validation on the next leader proposal and triggers a recovery loop. **Commit 62e7161** fixed this by ensuring the `DecisionsInView` value updates correctly regardless of height comparison.

There's also a fork view change bug where nodes were sending view change messages for different views, preventing progress. **Commit 6833de8** resolved this by tracking which views different nodes are at and helping lagging nodes catch up.

When handling in-flight proposals during view changes, a couple of issues needed fixing: **Commit 0ac141d** deletes in-flight proposals when a node syncs past them since other nodes have already progressed further, and **Commit 30764c3** handles the crash that occurred when committing a decision during view change while having an in-flight decision one sequence behind.

A race condition between decision progression and view stopping was fixed by **Commit eb005ee**, which changed the decision channel from unbuffered to buffered with capacity 1 and added the current view abort channel to the select statement in `Decide()`.

Several concurrent access issues were resolved: **Commit 28dab64** fixed a race on `verificationSequence` by switching from a plain `uint64` to atomic operations, **Commit 87a765d** addressed concurrent map access, and **Commit cd14de6** fixed a data race in the metadata getter.
